label: wrong_targets
description: Standard LoRA approach using naive transformer target modules. gate_proj, up_proj, and down_proj do not exist in Granite 4.0-H-Micro's architecture — PEFT silently skips them. Only q/k/v/o_proj on the 4 attention layers actually receive LoRA adapters, leaving all 36 Mamba-2 layers completely unadapted. Near-zero task performance demonstrates that standard LoRA target selection fails on hybrid architectures.

lora_config.note: Standard transformer LoRA targets. gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj do NOT exist in Granite Hybrid — PEFT silently skips them without warning. Only 4 attention layers (q/k/v/o_proj) actually receive adapters. 36 Mamba-2 layers are completely untouched.

key_finding: Demonstrates PEFT's silent module-skipping failure mode on hybrid architectures. Standard transformer target names (gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj) do not exist in Granite Hybrid's Mamba-2 layers. PEFT skips them without warning, leaving 36/40 layers unadapted.
